🚨 You can Now use Claude Code for $0
What used to require paid API calls now runs completely FREE using Ollama

Until this week, Anthropic's agentic coding tool ran exclusively on their API
Every token = money out of your pocket
That just changed

Ollama now supports Anthropic's API format !
Translation : Run Claude Code with open-source models. Locally. Free.

𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗲'𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟱-𝗺𝗶𝗻𝘂𝘁𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗽 :
1. Install Ollama 

2. Pull a coding model
ollama pull qwen2.5-coder 

3. Install Claude Code
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code 

4. Point to localhost
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=ollama
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434

5. Run it
claude --model qwen2.5-coder

What you get: 
→ Full agentic coding capabilities

items.text:
I'm an AI engineer.
I’ve led real projects and touched real systems.

And yet… I hesitate to call myself an “expert.”
Because I know how complex, evolving, and humbling this field really is.

But every time I scroll, I feel like I’m watching a parade of overnight experts.

People throwing around buzzwords. Selling courses.
Telling others how to “not get left behind” in AI
When they barely understand the difference between machine learning and magic.

Let’s be clear:
AI is powerful.
It is changing industries.
But it’s not a magic trick, and it shouldn’t be treated like one.

Fear marketing?
Promising secret formulas?
Pretending they’ve decoded the universe after 2 hours on ChatGPT?

We owe better to the people we’re trying to educate.
And I say this as someone who’s still learning too
Because anyone who really works in AI knows:

"The more you learn, the more humble you become"

If you’re new to AI:
Don’t be afraid to learn.
Just be mindful of who you learn from.

We don’t need more AI gurus.
We need real experts.


Image credits to Eduardo Ordax
